title: Ready alerts for chosen cooldowns
quote: I want a sound and a flash the moment Pain Suppression or Guardian Spirit is back, without staring at the list.
what: Pick spells and get a sound, a screen flash or a chat line when the cooldown for a groupmate (or you) comes back. Optional alert at 10 seconds left so you can plan the next call.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever: only fires for players who run the addon; works for everyone on Classic Era, TBC and MoP.
today: Today: timers and a green READY text, no sound or alert

title: Raid cooldown assignments
quote: Our plan says Aura Mastery on the second tank swap, and I want that on screen, not in a Discord note.
what: Build a list of who casts which cooldown at which time or boss phase. The panel shows the next assigned cast, who owns it, and flags it when the owner's spell is not ready. The leader can share the plan with the group.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever: the plan shares fine, but ready status only shows for addon users; full on Classic Era, TBC and MoP.
today: Today: no assignments, just the live list

title: External stacking warning
quote: Two externals on one tank wastes both, and I want to know before I press mine.
what: When a tracked external or big defensive is cast, show a short banner with the caster and a timer for the effect length, so other healers see it is covered right now.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever: you only see casts from addon users, and cast targets are hidden in combat; works from the combat log on Classic Era, TBC and MoP.
today: Today: shows cooldown remaining only, not the effect or target

title: Group by purpose
quote: I need externals, raid cooldowns and mana tools in separate blocks, not one list sorted by time.
what: Group the panel by type: externals, raid cooldowns, battle rez, mana, utility. Each block can be hidden or reordered, and the minimum cooldown filter can be set per block.
today: Today: one list sorted ready first then by time, one minimum duration setting

title: Mana cooldown strip and request
quote: On TBC I live and die by Mana Tide, Innervate and Shadowfiend, and I want those timers together.
what: A small strip for mana tools (Mana Tide Totem, Innervate, Shadowfiend, Hymn of Hope) showing who has it ready. It could also send a request line like the Request Rez button does, to call for an Innervate.
possible: Partly on Classic Era, TBC and MoP: reads the combat log so groupmates need no addon; Retail and WoW: Forever have few of these spells and hide the casts.
today: Today: the spells are tracked in the main list, no mana view or request

title: Click a row to call it
quote: When the boss hits, I click Guardian Spirit on the list and the raid sees the call without me typing.
what: Click a ready row to send a preset line to raid or party chat naming the cooldown and its owner, or whisper the owner. A modifier click could ask the owner to use it now.
today: Today: rows only display, the only call is Request Rez for battle rez

title: Compact icon strip for healers
quote: I run a tight UI, so give me small icons with timers instead of another wide panel.
what: Option to show cooldown icons with timers as a compact strip, grid or row, instead of the text list. Icons grey out on cooldown and glow when ready.
possible: Possible on every client: the addon draws its own icons, so no hidden values are needed beyond what it already shares.
today: Today: a text list panel, an Essentials bar and a lane bar, plus CDTL3 lanes

title: Healer-only view presets
quote: In a 20 man raid I only care about healing cooldowns and externals, not every class's utility.
what: Presets that show only healing cooldowns and externals, or only tank defensives, with a one click toggle on the panel title. Today the same thing means unticking spells one by one.
possible: Possible on every client: presets are fixed spell groups, no role detection needed.
today: Today: spells can be unticked one at a time, no presets

title: Battle rez charges and next rezzer
quote: I want to see charges left and who is next up to rez, so we do not burn two on one wipe.
what: Show the raid battle rez charge count and next recharge timer on the Essentials bar, plus an ordered list of who has a rez ready, so the raid leader can pick one.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever: the charge pool is readable for you, other players' rez readiness only if they run the addon; on Classic it reads from the combat log.
today: Today: ready providers shown with Request Rez, charge value read only for your own spell

title: Which cooldowns will be back for the next hit
quote: I want to line my cooldowns up against the fight and see what will be ready for the next big hit.
what: Type in a time (or use a pull timer) and the Lane view marks which cooldowns will be ready by then, and warns when none will be. It helps plan a rotation mid-fight.
possible: Partly on Retail and WoW: Forever: only for addon users, based on their shared casts; full on Classic Era, TBC and MoP.
today: Today: lanes show used to ready, no look ahead
